items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued May 10 at 10:30AM AKDT until May 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued May 10 at 10:10AM AKDT until May 10 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The National Weather Service in Fairbanks has issued a Red Flag
Warning, which is in effect from 4 PM this afternoon to 10 PM
AKDT this evening. A second Red Flag Warning has also been issued
from 10 AM to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* AFFECTED AREA...Delta Junction.

* TIMING...For the first Red Flag Warning, from 4 PM this
afternoon to 10 PM AKDT this evening. For the second Red Flag
Warning, from 10 AM to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* WINDS...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* HUMIDITY.
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 10 at 9:40AM AKDT until May 11 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Delta Junction.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidity and gusty winds
combined with dry fuels will lead to critical fire weather
conditions, particularly Sunday afternoon and Monday afternoon.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
